notes: Back to two stock traders: Gareth and Wren each get a $500 pot (topped up by $200). Old Bram, Ysolde and Pip stop trading; what they hold is sold by their own rules.
Pip becomes the Risk Manager: no new buys after a -$500 day, at most 20% of a pot in one stock, at most 50% in one industry.
Old Bram becomes the Validator: a hero whose strategy fails its tests makes no new buys.
Ysolde becomes the Execution Manager: every order has its own ID, nothing is sent twice, and a daily check compares Goldmire with Alpaca.
